notes: CPU increment applies only to free-idle time, exclusive state idle+increment; never overlaps radio current.
Only upper19dBm TX current inherits the original declared source conditions. Lower current and linear interpolation are assumptions, not a Nordic power curve.
Idle/RX currents transferred unchanged at14dBm are assumptions; original source catalog remains archived with exact conditions.
Beacon severity counts extra queued wake prepare+RX services per complete interval slot; no logical data delivery credit.
Retries force a seeded contiguous burst of initial failures then resume common baseline draws with an increased actual cap.
Fragment overhead applies only when extra fragments exist; each fragment has prepare/TX/RX/retry service, logical delivery requires all fragments.
Infeasible slot schedules are rejected before energy calculation; no clipping, hidden overflow or fabricated zero labels.
